changes.headline: Governor signed the End Data Center Tax Credits Act
changes.detail: Eliminates the remaining $250 million in uncommitted Next New Jersey AI/data-center tax credits and redirects the funds.

changes.headline: HB 233 signed; large-load tariff now required
changes.detail: Requires large users to bear dedicated infrastructure costs through a large-load tariff and allows the PSC to deny connections if ratepayer protections are insufficient.

changes.headline: Executive Order 2026-05 makes GRID requirements binding
changes.detail: Conditions permitting and tax incentives on GRID compliance, removes AI data centers from permit fast track, and requires local approval before state permits.

changes.headline: Executive Order 2026-494 raises permitting bar
changes.detail: Directs agencies to deny permits that harm ratepayers or environmental resources and requires developers to submit energy plans.

changes.headline: ERCOT interconnection audit halts advancing connections
changes.detail: Governor directed PUCT and ERCOT to verify all data centers advancing through the interconnection process; noncompliant projects can be denied connection.

changes.headline: SCC assigns dedicated transmission costs to large-load data centers
changes.detail: Large-load customers must pay for transmission facilities built solely to serve them, establishing a stronger cost-causation precedent.

changes.headline: Governor ends data-center access to ImagiNE Nebraska incentives
changes.detail: Executive order removes incentive eligibility and creates an interagency review and data-center task force.

changes.headline: Executive Order 62 creates one-year hyperscale permitting moratorium
changes.detail: Pauses state environmental permits for hyperscale facilities of 50 MW or more while agencies develop a new regulatory framework.

radar.headline: Joint Subcommittee tax-policy recommendations due
radar.detail: Recommendations could reshape the data-center sales/use tax framework after the 2026 budget compromise.

radar.headline: Statewide moratorium proposal expected in 2027 session
radar.detail: Sponsors have previewed a two-to-five-year moratorium framework and companion legislation targeting the microgrid pathway.

radar.headline: Incentive repeal and new operating guardrails expected
radar.detail: Governor has pledged to pursue sales-tax exemption repeal plus water-efficient cooling, added generation and siting requirements.

radar.headline: Policy recommendations from Governor-directed review
radar.detail: The 2026 executive review is expected to inform legislation on water, power and responsible data-center development.

radar.headline: Moratorium proposal and incentive framework return to legislature
radar.detail: Legislators announced a three-year moratorium proposal while enterprise-zone eligibility remains paused pending the 2027 session.
